$comment: docs/localization.md §L9.4 — every ICU argument that carries a user or technical value into a localized sentence, and the isolate it takes. A value entering through an ICU ARGUMENT has no element to carry `dir`, so markup cannot reach it. Each site names the resolved KEY SET, the argument slot and the isolate kind; `scripts/check-isolate-arguments.mjs` asserts all three against the AST.
$address: A site is addressed by (file, enclosing function, RESOLVED KEY SET). That one address covers every shape: a literal key is a one-member set, a computed key is an n-member set, and two calls sharing a key are two entries. The previous schema needed a `keyAuthority` special case per shape and C3.5 added three more — a local `const` holding a conditional, an inline conditional, and a map lookup with a `??` fallback.
$limit: This manifest defends the call sites listed here, exactly and in both directions. It does NOT by itself discover a NEW ICU argument that starts carrying a user value later — that half is `scripts/check-icu-arguments.mjs`, which enumerates EVERY ICU argument in shipped source and refuses one that is neither mechanically classifiable nor dispositioned. The two together close the population; neither alone does. `scripts/content-direction.json` still carries the original unbounded limit, because a new text-rendering ELEMENT is a different question and only a census finds that.
$history: PR B recorded 11 decision rows and deferred them. C3.5 re-ran the population from the TypeScript type checker — 205 ICU arguments — and found 27 more that carry user or technical values: 8 in its first pass (the unrecognized-column header and the five `import.loc.*` calls) and 19 that its first pass only RECORDED as open. All 27 are implemented here, so no row of the disposition manifest is classed `auto`, `ltr` or `per-fragment` any more.
